name: Maybe_1
short_caption: The robot tilts its head slightly to the side with a gentle shoulder shrug, expressing mild uncertainty or a 'maybe' sentiment.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and begins by subtly lifting its shoulders while tilting its head to its right side. Its hands turn slightly outward in a subtle shrugging gesture. It holds this gentle, questioning pose briefly before smoothly bringing its head back to center and lowering its arms back into the neutral rest posture.
